dependent_variable.name: Δ/MVA1
dependent_variable.definition: One-year cash-tax nonconformity Δ scaled by beginning market value of assets MVA1, with beginning book value of assets substituted when MVA is missing. Table 4 defines Δ as TXPD less the change in TXR and .35 times pre-tax income. Section 2.2 calls TXR a tax refund receivable and reports τ=34% for fiscal years ended 1998 through 1992 and 35% for 1993–2014; Table 4 instead calls TXR tax reserves and specifies .35×PI. These source discrepancies are unresolved; the formula follows the measure-specific Table 4 definition.
dependent_variable.formula: ((TXPD − (TXR_t − TXR_{t−1})) − 0.35×PI) / MVA1; MVA = BVA + (MVE − BVE); MVA1 is beginning MVA, computed as AT + ((PRCC_Q×CSHO) − SEQ), with beginning BVA substituted when MVA is missing.

evidence.quote: Δ is equal to cash taxes paid minus the change in tax reserves
(TXPD – (TXRt – TXRt-1))
less the statutory rate times pre-tax book income (.35 * PI)
Therefore, we adjust cash taxes paid by the change (δ) in a firm’s tax refund receivable (TXR).
We set τ equal to 34% for fiscal years ended 1998 through 1992 and to 35% for fiscal years ended 1993 through 2014 in our analyses.
MVA 1⁄4 BVA þ ðMVE−BVEÞ ð4Þ
where BVA is equal to a firm’s book value of assets, MVE is the firm’s market value of equity, and BVE is the firm’s book value of equity.
MVA1, MVA5, and MVA10 are equal to the sum of beginning market value of assets
MVA is replaced with beginning book value of assets (BVA) when missing.

review_notes: Principal eligible family: Table 6 Panel C, all-firms regression of the new one-year Δ/MVA1 measure on TIME. The paper’s central claim concerns how the full population’s tax-avoidance picture changes when loss and negative-tax-expense firms are included. Panels A–B replicate profitable-subsample results; Panel C’s multinational/domestic fits and contrast are subsequent subgroup analyses and are excluded.
No fitted regression constructs Δ/MVA1: its inputs and scalar are deterministic accounting calculations. No supporting construction regression is required.

The trend estimator is not named, so method remains unknown. The source also has unresolved construction discrepancies: Section 2.2 calls TXR a tax refund receivable and reports a 34%/35% statutory-rate rule with an internally reversed 1998–1992 range, while Table 4 calls TXR tax reserves and specifies .35×PI.
results_review_notes: Table 4 Panel A reports one-year Δ/MVA1 distributions for the full, positive-PTI/CTE, and negative-PTI/CTE groups; Table 6 reports only the TIME range. Δ/BVA1 is an alternate scaling measure, not an upstream raw input/component of retained Δ/MVA1, so it is not included.

calculation_provenance.policy: strict; no guessed degrees of freedom or normal approximations
